scripts.dev:worktree: IDEXAL_DEV_MODE=1 IDEXAL_DEV_PROFILE=auto IDEXAL_ELECTRON_USE_MOCK_KEYCHAIN=${IDEXAL_ELECTRON_USE_MOCK_KEYCHAIN:-1} IDEXAL_ELECTRON_REMOTE_DEBUG_PORT=0 PORT=0 pnpm --filter @idexal/desktop dev
scripts.dev:den:mysql: docker compose -p idexal-os-den-local -f packaging/docker/docker-compose.web-local.yml up -d --wait mysql redis
scripts.dev:den:api: DEN_WEB_PORT=${DEN_WEB_PORT:-3005}; IDEXAL_APP_PORT=${IDEXAL_APP_PORT:-5173}; DEN_LOCAL_ORIGINS=http://localhost:$DEN_WEB_PORT,http://127.0.0.1:$DEN_WEB_PORT,http://localhost:$IDEXAL_APP_PORT,http://127.0.0.1:$IDEXAL_APP_PORT; IDEXAL_DEV_MODE=1 DEN_PASSWORD_BREACH_SCREENING_ENABLED=${DEN_PASSWORD_BREACH_SCREENING_ENABLED:-false} PORT=${DEN_API_PORT:-8790} DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-mysql://root:password@127.0.0.1:3306/idexal_os_den} DATABASE_REDIS_URL=${DATABASE_REDIS_URL:-redis://127.0.0.1:6379} DEN_DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY=${DEN_DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY:-local-dev-db-encryption-key-please-change-1234567890} BETTER_AUTH_SECRET=${BETTER_AUTH_SECRET:-local-dev-secret-not-for-production-use!!} DEN_BASE_URL=${DEN_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:$DEN_WEB_PORT} DEN_BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=${DEN_BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS:-$DEN_LOCAL_ORIGINS} CORS_ORIGINS=${CORS_ORIGINS:-$DEN_LOCAL_ORIGINS} DEN_DIAGNOSTICS_ORIGIN=${DEN_DIAGNOSTICS_ORIGIN:-https://diagnostic.idexal.com} DEN_DIAGNOSTICS_BEARER_TOKEN=${DEN_DIAGNOSTICS_BEARER_TOKEN:-IdexalOsDiagnosticsToken!} PROVISIONER_MODE=${PROVISIONER_MODE:-stub} pnpm --filter @idexal-ee/den-api dev:local
scripts.dev:den:gateway: DEN_WEB_PORT=${DEN_WEB_PORT:-3005}; IDEXAL_APP_PORT=${IDEXAL_APP_PORT:-5173}; GATEWAY_PORT=${GATEWAY_PORT-${INFERENCE_PORT:-8791}}; DEN_LOCAL_ORIGINS=http://localhost:$DEN_WEB_PORT,http://127.0.0.1:$DEN_WEB_PORT,http://localhost:$IDEXAL_APP_PORT,http://127.0.0.1:$IDEXAL_APP_PORT; IDEXAL_DEV_MODE=1 PORT=$GATEWAY_PORT DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-mysql://root:password@127.0.0.1:3306/idexal_os_den} DEN_DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY=${DEN_DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY:-local-dev-db-encryption-key-please-change-1234567890} CORS_ORIGINS=${CORS_ORIGINS:-$DEN_LOCAL_ORIGINS} GATEWAY_PROXY_BASE_URL=${GATEWAY_PROXY_BASE_URL-${INFERENCE_PROXY_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:$GATEWAY_PORT}} GATEWAY_ADMIN_TOKEN=${GATEWAY_ADMIN_TOKEN-${INFERENCE_ADMIN_TOKEN:-local-dev-admin-token}} GATEWAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET=${GATEWAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET-${INFERENCE_WEBHOOK_SECRET:-local-dev-webhook-secret}} pnpm --filter @idexal-ee/gateway dev:local
scripts.dev:den:web: DEN_API_PORT=${DEN_API_PORT:-8790}; DEN_WEB_PORT=${DEN_WEB_PORT:-3005}; IDEXAL_DEV_MODE=1 NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY= NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_API_KEY= DEN_API_BASE=${DEN_API_BASE:-http://localhost:$DEN_API_PORT} DEN_BASE_URL=${DEN_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:$DEN_WEB_PORT} DEN_AUTH_ORIGIN=${DEN_AUTH_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:$DEN_WEB_PORT} DEN_AUTH_FALLBACK_BASE=${DEN_AUTH_FALLBACK_BASE:-http://localhost:$DEN_API_PORT} pnpm --filter @idexal-ee/den-web dev:local
